title: The Cave-In
text: The roof comes down behind you with a roar. Then comes silence, with dust so thick you cannot see your hands. When it clears, the way back is gone, sealed with a wall of broken stone. Somewhere in the dark ahead, something has heard.

options.label: Everyone digs, in the dark, and nobody speaks of what is listening.

outcomes.text: You dig for hours in silence, hands bleeding. Ahead, something listens but never comes closer.

options.label: The strongest clears the rubble, stone by stubborn stone.

outcomes.text: The work goes faster, though the stone fights them every inch, as if it wants you to stay.

options.label: Go forward. There is no going back now, so meet whatever heard you.

outcomes.text: You go deeper into the dark, where the thing that heard you is waiting.
